headline: Michael Young's ninth-inning single walks off Rockies
recap: Trailing 3-2 in the bottom of the ninth, the Phillies rallied to beat the Colorado Rockies 4-3 at Citizens Bank Park. Erik Kratz led off with a double and was replaced by pinch-runner Casper Wells, who moved to third on John Mayberry Jr.'s groundout and scored the tying run on Carlos Ruiz's double. After Jimmy Rollins was intentionally walked, Michael Young lined a single to left field to score Ruiz and end the game.

Cliff Lee started for the Phillies and allowed two earned runs on nine hits over seven innings, striking out six without issuing a walk; Chase Utley's solo home run in the first briefly put Philadelphia ahead before Wilin Rosario's homer and a Dexter Fowler RBI single gave Colorado a 2-1 lead in the second. Rockies starter Juan Nicasio worked 5 2/3 innings and was charged with one earned run.

Colorado retook the lead in the top of the eighth when Nolan Arenado's single scored Charlie Blackmon off reliever Justin De Fratus, making it 3-2. Jake Diekman worked a scoreless top of the ninth to pick up the win, and Rafael Betancourt, who entered to protect the lead, took the loss and was charged with a blown save.
